description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty, which is part of the HTML Purifier library and responsible for removing empty HTML elements during the purification process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty
classes.description: A class responsible for removing empty HTML elements in the purification process based on specific configuration rules.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, setting flags for removing nbsp and preparing the predicate exclusions.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Processes an HTML token to determine whether to remove it if it is an empty element, considering whitespace, attributes, and exclusion rules.
